sources after identification of manpower requirement.

development.

administration, engagement, and resolution of employee grievances.
 Resourceful in designing, developing & executing various Business-led Programs for enhancing
organizational competencies & establishing high performance mindset.
 Using HRMS Software for updating management staff database, employee benefits
 Experience in Essl and Easy time Pro kind of Attendance Tracking Software to overseeing attendance records,

 Skilled in administering smooth implementation of HR policies & system for organizational effectiveness.
 A methodical professional with a deep sense of ethics and integrity
Experience Summary
Talent Acquisition
• Handle the entire tactical Talent Acquisition process.
• Communicate all compensation, benefits & other policies, and formalities properly to candidate.
• Finalize offer letters and fitment as per defined matrix
• Coordinate with Hod’s for interview schedules.
• Resolve any reimbursement/consultant payment related issue
• Designing and ensuring proper implementation of GET/MT Program
Employee Engagement Activities
• Finalize the annual engagement calendar.Track and highlight engagement budget variances
• Executes employee engagement surveys basis identified levers to be measured and coordinate with the
external partner for survey floating and implementation.
• Execute events as per Annual engagement Calendar. (e.g. Town hall meeting, Birthday celebration, Safety
week, Kaizen Competition, Circle Meetings, Blood donation camp. Health checkup camps, Family get together
Etc.)
• Coordination of various Engagement committee meetings. (POSH/ Canteen/Sports/ safety) Member of IC
committee.
Performance Management
• Communicate, resolve queries, and drive cascade through KRA/goal setting principles in terms of SMART
(specific, measurable, achievable, realistic, and timely) goals, objective measurement parameters, goal
weightage etc.
• Coordinate for completion of Mid-year and end year reviews.
• Ensure expectations and feedback from multiple stakeholders during the performance review process are
taken during rating normalization and rewards linkage decisions
• Drive capability building of managers and employees in having performance and feedback conversations to
build the skill around the system
Onboarding & offboarding Formalities
• HRMS entry/ document verification/ organization announcement of new joiner.
• Induction & Orientation of new joiner
• Exit interview of resigned employee.
• Separation action & relieving letters of left employees.
MIS (Management Information System) & Audit Support
 Preparing and maintaining the MIS reports and submitting the same to the decision-making panel of
the organization for fine tuning the business strategies.
 Responsible for various customer & internal Audits (Eg. IATF, EHS, OHSAS, ISO, 5S)
Welfare Activities
 Conduct all welfare activities as per employee welfare calendar, in collaboration with Union and other
employee committees (Eg. Shoes/ uniform/ Medical checkups/ etc.)
 Ensure transportation, Canteen, Medical facilities are run as per policy and guidelines.
Organization Design & Manpower Planning
 Support in data collection and implementation of relevant Manpower Planning techniques medical facilities
for self and family of employees
 Ensure updation of organization charts as and when required as per decisions and policies.
 Ensure approvals for MPRs for recruitment as per manpower plan and authority level/matrix
 Measure the impact of Attraction and Retention initiatives taken and prepare reports along with Attrition
numbers to present to senior stakeholders
Driving and Execution of HR Policies/SOPs:
 Set up and Execution of HR Policies within the Organization
 Communicating HR policies & procedures across organization like Leave, Travel, Mediclaim, Induction,
Recruitments, Exit, Welfare, Ethics, Code of Conduct etc.
 Employee Engagement Activities.
Diversity and Inclusion
 Driving and initiating various diversity initiatives (Gender, Generation, Culture & Internationality)
 Moderating various workshops to discuss and understand diversity and enhance inclusion.
 Mentoring and coaching
Compensation & Benefit:
 Salary surveys, salary benchmarking, compensation policies, benefits policies, rewards, medical, insurance.
 Classifying the wage structure into the different wage components and reducing the organizational cost
strategically.
 Monitoring the salary structures and identifying the areas of improvement. Taking care of Employee payroll
Management
